mapper.sql: SELECT sys05_user_role_id AS user_role_id, sys05_user_id AS user_id, sys05_role_id AS role_id, sys05_auth_org_id AS auth_org_id, f_org_nm(sys05_auth_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS auth_org_nm, org00_kor_nm AS org_nm, f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_nm, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, org00_parent_full_nm AS parent_full_nm FROM sys05_user_role , emp01_person , emp03_trans , org00_org_info WHERE sys05_user_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) AND emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date )
mapper.select: AND sys05_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY org00_org_cd, f_org_seq(org00_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date, emp01_company_id), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys04_role WHERE sys04_role_id = #{roleId} AND sys04_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{userId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys05_user_role WHERE sys05_user_id = #{userId} AND sys05_role_id = #{roleId} AND sys05_user_role_id != #{userRoleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys05_user_role (sys05_user_role_id, sys05_user_id, sys05_role_id, sys05_auth_org_id) VALUES (#{userRoleId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{authOrgId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys05_user_role WHERE sys05_role_id IN (SELECT sys04_role_id FROM sys04_role WHERE sys04_company_id = #{companyId}) AND sys05_user_role_id IN #{id}
